g.text: 🧠 Why Event-Driven Architecture fits this system

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Loose coupling - orders service does not depend on vendor systems directly

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Asynchronous processing - order creation is fast, processing happens in background

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Scalability - kafka allows horizontal scaling of consumers under load

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Resilience - vendor failures do not affect order creation flow

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Reliability - events can be retried and safely delivered (e.g. via outbox pattern)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Extensibility - new consumers (analytics, notifications, fraud checks) can be added easily
